name: Genomics and Proteomics
description: Molecular biology review for omics; introduction to genomics and first generation sequencing; the 'human genome project'; next (second) generation sequencing; third generation sequencing; application of genomics: genome assembly, metagenomics, and counting molecular events - DNA-DNA, and DNA-protein interactions; introduction to transcriptomics and RNA-sequencing data analysis; sample multiplexing and high-throughput sequencing applications - single cell sequencing and spatial transcriptomics; introduction to proteomics and first generation proteomics; mass-spectrometry and second generation proteomics; application of proteomics. Quantitative proteomics - protein dynamics; studying protein-protein interactions; introduction to metabolomics. Applications of metabolomics - lipidomics.
